item.title: MONGOOSE VS KING COBRA | The World's Longest Venomous Snake
item.description:
Deep in a forest where the MONGOOSE and the world's longest venomous snake hunts. A grey mongoose does something that shouldn't be possible — she stands her ground against a king cobra, and walks away.
Our team spent three weeks tracking a mongoose den in king cobra's range to answer one question: why doesn't venom that can kill almost anything else in this forest stop her? The answer isn't "fearless." It's a documented, published biological mechanism — a reshaped receptor that resists the toxin's grip, not a free pass from it.
This is Built Different: Mongoose vs King Cobra — the real science behind one of the only mammals on Earth with measurable resistance to elapid venom, and what happens when that resistance is actually put to the test.
